scope: Exploratory conditional bound chosen after source inspection and prior mass-model failures; not a decipherment or independent quantity prediction
premises: Selected complete fields encode reported surviving masses on a common additive scalar scale
The whole M108 group contributes the same amount A on both axes
Small axe's other signs have net contribution r>=0, so S=A+r
Seven-arch M315 contributes7u, so L=A+7u with no additional unencoded component in this selected field
K121 selected candidate interpretation contains at least n arch units u plus a nonnegative contribution q, so K=n*u+q, with u>=0
Weak branch n=1 covers1u,2u,and u+2i only when their remaining contributions are nonnegative; stronger n=2 requires the disputed2u interpretation
proof: A<=S and u<=K/n, so L<=S+7K/n. Positive D=L-S-7K/n rejects the combined premises
damage_extension: For added missing masses dS,dL,dK>=0 the necessary inequality becomes dS+(7/n)dK-dL>=D. These are model requirements, not observed losses
limits: K121 graphical interpretation remains disputed; M77M313 normalization is not proof of two equivalent units
Other sides are not concatenated with candidate quantity fields
Negative residuals, multiplicative operations, context-dependent units, or different quantity targets alter the tested model
Published mass decimals are not balance uncertainty estimates; original masses are unknown
